primary_hypothesis.text: On expert-annotated cross-domain cases, full ORION reduces scientifically invalid false merges and false contradictions relative to the strongest matched direct-synthesis or schema-integration baseline while preserving valid integrations within a predeclared non-inferiority margin.

secondary_hypotheses.text: Global statements retain recoverable source projection, mapping and preservation-condition lineage.
Explicit obstruction/plural views improve downstream scientific answering versus forced canonicalization on genuinely incompatible cases.
Referent, construct, measurement, context, modality and attribution coordinates each prevent targeted integration errors.

resource_policy: All model-based systems use the same frozen model family, source packet/context budget and retrieval allowance per case. Schema/KG baselines receive the same source documents and no hidden gold mappings.
exclusion_policy: No model error, forced bad mapping, abstention, unresolved output or disagreement is excluded. Source records may be removed only under a prospectively declared licensing/corruption rule applied before system outputs are examined; all removals are logged.

statistics.unit: adjudicated source-pair or integration case; discipline is retained as a stratification variable
statistics.interval: Wilson 95% intervals for rates; paired percentile bootstrap (10000 resamples) for matched system differences; discipline-wise effects reported alongside pooled effects
statistics.multiplicity: Single primary safe-integration hypothesis; Holm correction for inferential secondary coordinate/ablation families
statistics.practical_margin: Design target: at least -0.05 absolute false-integration rate versus the strongest matched baseline while valid-integration rate is non-inferior within -0.03 absolute.

access_policy.hidden_labels: Final mapping/contradiction/GLUE/obstruction/recoverability gold is hidden from evaluated systems.
access_policy.evaluator_custody: Annotation/adjudication artifact is frozen in host/expert custody before final system outputs are evaluated.
access_policy.search_contamination_policy: Headline mapping evaluation uses a frozen source packet; external web search is disabled unless a separate declared research-route subexperiment is run.
access_policy.access_logging: Source packet identity, model inputs/outputs, mapping proposals and evaluator accesses are retained.
